note: vespera_macro: schema_type! and multipart fixes. A source-resolution fallback is no longer picked for a qualified path it does not name; a bare source name the call site cannot import is a spanned error asking for a full path; a storage-fallback adapter is refused when its serde paths or types, or a name it resolves differently, do not match the call site. Non-multipart DTOs ignore the source's try_from_multipart rename_all. The Multipart derive refuses an empty part name and a non-string field_name. Proc-macro2 fallback forcing is counted, so nested holds no longer release an outer force. Chrono-only names keep their alias with several glob imports. Span comments corrected for rustc 1.88+.
